def factor_volume_lead_coherence_robust_surprise(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy['close'].pct_change()
    vol_median = df_copy['volume'].rolling(20, min_periods=10).median()
    vol_std = df_copy['volume'].rolling(20, min_periods=10).std(ddof=1)
    vol_surprise = (df_copy['volume'] - vol_median) / vol_std.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    vol_surprise = vol_surprise.clip(-3.0, 3.0).fillna(0.0)
    vol_lag1 = vol_surprise.shift(1)
    lead_corr = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=10).corr(vol_lag1)
    contemp_corr = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=10).corr(vol_surprise)
    raw_diff = lead_corr - contemp_corr
    factor = raw_diff.ewm(span=5, min_periods=1).mean()
    factor = factor.fillna(0.0)
    factor.name = 'factor_volume_lead_coherence_robust_surprise'
    return factor
